outcome: concordance rates between MRI, ultrasound, operative, and pathologic diagnoses of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
cohort: 59 patients with a history of cesarean delivery and a diagnosis of PAS on post-operative pathology report, who underwent placental MRI prior to delivery between 2008-2022
finding: The use of structured reporting for placental MRI was associated with decreased discordance between imaging and intraoperative or pathologic diagnoses, leading to improved patient outcomes including decreased blood loss and blood transfusion.
